title: Embedded complete restriction
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite subextension of Qbar_ell, pi a generator of the maximal ideal of its embedded valuation ring, and X a Noetherian scheme. Using the canonical embedded coefficient maps and quotient-kernel predicates of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients], restriction from continuous to constant integral coefficients gives an equivalence on complete derived objects. The composite of this equivalence with the ambient inclusion is naturally isomorphic to the inclusion followed by the specified restriction functor.

proof.text: Use the ambient coefficient-presentation equivalences and their comparison with the specified restriction functor.

proof.text: The lifted integer ring is Noetherian, since the embedded integer ring is a principal ideal ring. Apply ConstantCompletion.equivalence to its lifted uniformizer ideal. Local completeness is invariant under isomorphism: apply functoriality of slice restriction and derived internal Hom.

proof.text: Restrict the two ambient equivalences using Mathlib Equivalence.congrFullSubcategory. Compose the forward comparison, the general completion equivalence, and the inverse constant-coefficient comparison. Whisker the two functor isomorphisms, reassociate composition, and cancel the coefficient equivalence using its unit. This produces exactly the required ambient functor comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem embeddedIntegral_complete_restriction
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    ∃ e : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X) ≌
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IntegralModelsEmbedded.constantComplete ℓ E π X),
      Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IntegralModelsEmbedded.constantComplete ℓ E π X) ≅
        ObjectProperty.ι (IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X) ⋙
          IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X)
